n-k-k4-01.title: Shortened notice
n-k-k4-01.goal: Compare classmate short summary with library notice, find lines wey change meaning, and fix one.
n-k-k4-01.material:
New classmate ask 현우 about school library rules. 현우 read notice below and write short summary.

[도서관 이용 안내]
- 이용 시간: 평일 오전 9시~오후 5시 / 토요일 오전 9시~낮 12시 / 일요일은 쉽니다.
- 책은 한 번에 5권까지, 2주 동안 빌릴 수 있어요.
- 늦게 반납하면 늦은 날 수만큼 책을 빌릴 수 없어요.
- 음료는 뚜껑이 있는 물병만 가지고 들어갈 수 있어요.
n-k-k4-01.thinking.1: Compare copy with source line by line
n-k-k4-01.prereq.1: Know 평일, 토요일, 일요일, 빌리다 and 돌려주다
n-k-k4-01.s.s1.prompt: 현우 summary below. Some lines say something different from notice. Choose one.
n-k-k4-01.s.s1.hint.0: Check summary one line at a time and find matching line in notice.
n-k-k4-01.s.s1.hint.1: For each line ask: notice say exactly this, or summary change day, duration or condition?
n-k-k4-01.s.s1.hint.2: Check lines with day, number of days or word for ‘any.’
n-k-k4-01.s.s1.explain: Lines 2, 5 and 6 wrong. Notice say 일요일은 쉽니다 (closed Sunday), borrowing ban last only same number of days as book late, and only water bottle with lid allowed. Lines 1, 3 and 4 match.
n-k-k4-01.s.s2.prompt: Last line of summary sound short and friendly. Why problem for new classmate?
n-k-k4-01.s.s2.hint.0: Put line 6 beside last line of notice.
n-k-k4-01.s.s2.hint.1: Find small word in notice wey limit which drinks allowed, and check if summary keep am.
n-k-k4-01.s.s2.o.a: She go think she cannot bring any drink.
n-k-k4-01.s.s2.r.a: Summary no ban drinks; e allow every kind, opposite mistake.
n-k-k4-01.s.s2.o.b: She go think drinks allowed only on weekdays.
n-k-k4-01.s.s2.r.b: Summary no talk which days drinks allowed. Problem na missing condition about which drink.
n-k-k4-01.s.s2.o.c: She fit bring drink wey no allowed because condition drop.
n-k-k4-01.s.s2.o.d: She go think library allow food as well as drinks.
n-k-k4-01.s.s2.r.d: This line only about drinks; food no mention.
n-k-k4-01.s.s2.explain: Summary fit be wrong without any wrong word: 아무거나 remove condition (뚜껑이 있는 물병만). Dropping conditions common way to change rule.
n-k-k4-01.s.s3.prompt: Rewrite drink line (last line of summary) in Korean so e say same as notice. Use polite -요.
n-k-k4-01.s.s3.hint.0: Go back to last notice line and find which drinks allowed.
n-k-k4-01.s.s3.hint.1: Which condition summary line lose? Put am back.
n-k-k4-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: My line keep both lid and water bottle?
n-k-k4-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: New student wey read only my line go bring right thing?

n-k-k4-02.title: Free cake for birthday?
n-k-k4-02.goal: Join flyer with friend text, figure which facts decide whether plan work, and tell friend wetin to do.
n-k-k4-02.material:
Today na 수요일. Friend 하나 send text and give cafe flyer too.

[카페 봄날 생일 이벤트]
- 생일인 손님은 케이크 한 조각이 무료예요.
- 생일 3일 전까지 전화로 예약해 주세요. (예: 생일이 금요일이면 화요일까지)
- 일요일은 이벤트를 하지 않아요.
- 신분증을 가지고 오세요.

하나의 문자 (Hana message): ‘내 생일이 이번 주 토요일이야! 카페 봄날에서 무료 케이크 먹자. 예약은 나중에 할게.’
n-k-k4-02.s.s1.prompt: Which TWO facts decide whether 하나 plan go work? Choose both.
n-k-k4-02.s.s1.hint.0: Which facts together give you a date?
n-k-k4-02.s.s1.hint.1: Check each fact: e fit make plan fail before 하나 reach cafe?
n-k-k4-02.s.s1.r.b: 하나 birthday na Saturday, so Sunday rule no matter for this plan.
n-k-k4-02.s.s1.r.d: This must happen at cafe, but e no decide whether plan still work.
n-k-k4-02.s.s1.r.e: Na reason for plan, no be rule to check.
n-k-k4-02.s.s1.explain: Reservation rule and birthday day must combine: Saturday birthday plus ‘by 3 days before’ give deadline, wey fit be close.
n-k-k4-02.s.s2.prompt: Use flyer example. Today na 수요일. For Saturday birthday, which last day to reserve?
n-k-k4-02.s.s2.hint.0: Use flyer example as pattern: count back same number of days from birthday.
n-k-k4-02.s.s2.hint.1: Write days in order Saturday, Friday, Thursday, ... and stop at correct count.
n-k-k4-02.s.s2.r.a: Thursday only 2 days before Saturday, so e don too late.
n-k-k4-02.s.s2.r.c: Tuesday na 4 days before Saturday. Use example: Friday birthday gives Tuesday.
n-k-k4-02.s.s2.r.d: Monday na 5 days before Saturday; example (Friday birthday, Tuesday) show 3 days before.
n-k-k4-02.s.s2.explain: Friday to Tuesday na 3 days back, so Saturday to Wednesday same distance. Today Wednesday, so today last day.
n-k-k4-02.s.s3.prompt: Write short Korean text to 하나 in friendly -요 speech. Tell her wetin to do and by when, and why.
n-k-k4-02.s.s3.hint.0: Start with day: when she must act?
n-k-k4-02.s.s3.hint.1: Say wetin she must do (what and how) and add reason with -아서/-어서 or -니까.
n-k-k4-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: My text mention today, what to do and why?
n-k-k4-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: 하나 know wetin to do after reading?
n-k-k4-02.s.s3.modelNote.0: Name today, the call and reason.

n-k-k4-03.title: Tickets for group
n-k-k4-03.goal: Turn friend text with hidden ratio rule into exact conditions, build several groups wey fit, and report one in Korean.
n-k-k4-03.material:
Friend 서연 text before you buy amusement park tickets:

‘놀이공원에 같이 가요. 어른 한 명이 어린이 두 명까지 데리고 갈 수 있대요. 어린이도 한 명은 가야 해요. 모두 5명 이상 가고 싶어요. 표값은 모두 합쳐서 6만 원까지 쓸 수 있어요.’

(1만 원 = 10,000원, so 6만 원 = 60,000원. Group na only adults and children you list.)

[표값]
어른 한 명: 10,000원
어린이 한 명: 6,000원
n-k-k4-03.thinking.0: Read rule wey connect two numbers
n-k-k4-03.prereq.1: Know numbers, 명, 어른, 어린이 and -까지
n-k-k4-03.prereq.2: Know 만 (10,000) in prices like 3만 8천 원
n-k-k4-03.s.s1.prompt: Wetin ‘어른 한 명이 어린이 두 명까지 데리고 갈 수 있대요’ tell you?
n-k-k4-03.s.s1.hint.0: Try rule with 1 adult first: how many children fit come?
n-k-k4-03.s.s1.hint.1: Then try 2 adults and see how number grow.
n-k-k4-03.s.s1.o.a: 1 adult fit bring up to 2 children.
n-k-k4-03.s.s1.o.b: Each adult must bring exactly 2 children.
n-k-k4-03.s.s1.r.b: ‘까지’ give highest limit, no be required number.
n-k-k4-03.s.s1.r.c: Rule say 2 children for each adult, no be 1.
n-k-k4-03.s.s1.o.d: Each child need 2 adults to go with am.
n-k-k4-03.s.s1.r.d: That reverse rule: here 1 adult fit bring 2 children.
n-k-k4-03.s.s1.explain: ‘-까지’ set limit: 1 adult fit bring up to 2 children, so with 2 adults max 4 children fit go.
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.prompt: Find 3 groups wey meet every condition in message, each with different number of adults. a = adults, c = children.
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.hint.0: Write conditions in your own words first, one per line.
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.hint.1: Start with a = 2 and look for child numbers wey meet child rule and 5-person rule.
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.fail.c0: People counts must be whole numbers.
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.fail.c1: Need at least 1 adult, and message say at least 1 child (어린이도 한 명은).
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.ok.c2: No more than 2 children for each adult.
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Children too many: each adult fit bring up to 2 (어린이 두 명까지).
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.fail.c3: Message want 5 people or more (모두 5명 이상).
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.explain: For example, 2 adults + 3 children = 38,000 won; 3 + 3 = 48,000 won; 4 + 2 = 52,000 won. Many groups fit because message give limits, no be exact group.
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.because.prompt: Choose ONE group and send 서연 short Korean text (polite -요): adults first, then children, then total price. Write numbers as digits or Korean number words.
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.because.hint.0: Use one group above: which two numbers?
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.because.hint.1: Say adults first, then children, then total in won.
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Counts in my text match one group I built?
n-k-k4-03.s.s3.prompt: 서연 cousin suggest: ‘어른 5명이랑 어린이 2명이 가요. 모두 7명이고 5만 8천 원이에요.’ Which condition does plan break?
n-k-k4-03.s.s3.hint.0: Check plan against every message condition, one by one.
n-k-k4-03.s.s3.hint.1: Do every calculation yourself; no rely on numbers written in plan.
n-k-k4-03.s.s3.r.a: 5 adults fit bring up to 10 children, and plan get only 2.
n-k-k4-03.s.s3.r.b: There are 7 people, so 5-person condition met.
n-k-k4-03.s.s3.r.c: Plan get 2 children, so minimum-one-child condition met.
n-k-k4-03.s.s3.o.d: Tickets really cost 62,000 won, above limit.
n-k-k4-03.s.s3.explain: 5 adults cost 50,000 won, 2 children cost 12,000 won, total 62,000 won, more than 60,000. Number in plan wrong. Always calculate total yourself instead of copying am.

n-k-k4-04.s.s1.hint.0: Decide using only wetin you don read so far.
n-k-k4-04.title: Snack offer
n-k-k4-04.goal: Read short conversation in stages, change interpretation as new sentences arrive, then reply so nobody need guess.
n-k-k4-04.material: You dey school cafeteria with classmate 지우. You bring out bag of crackers.
n-k-k4-04.thinking.2: Write reply wey nobody fit misread
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.prompt: Read each part, choose most likely interpretation and continue.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.hint.1: Look for words wey give reason or time after first answer.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Both meanings possible: 괜찮아요 fit accept or turn down offer. One short answer no enough.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Nothing mention another snack; she only answer offer.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.0.o.d: She dey ask wetin kind crackers dem be.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Her answer short and polite, no be question.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Now wetin 지우 most likely mean?
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.1.after: ‘-아서요’ give reason. Eating plenty at lunch make ‘no thanks’ better reading.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.1.o.a: She want crackers because she eat plenty at lunch.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Big lunch na reason not to eat more, so e point to refusal.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.1.o.b: She politely dey say no because she full.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.1.r.d: She answer with reason about eating, so she hear am.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Now full picture clear: no for now, maybe yes later. First 괜찮아요 alone no show that.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Not now, but maybe one cracker later.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: She ask for one later, so she no reject am forever.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: She say 이따가 (later), no be now.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.2.o.d: She wan make you put crackers away.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.2.r.d: She ask for one later, so she want you keep dem.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.reflect: 괜찮아요 fit mean ‘yes, fine’ or ‘no thanks.’ Words after it (reason, time) decide which. Polite answer fit still unclear.
n-k-k4-04.s.s2.prompt: Friend 민호 offer snack. Which reply 민호 fit misunderstand easiest?
n-k-k4-04.s.s2.hint.0: For each reply ask: after reading, 민호 know whether to give snack now?
n-k-k4-04.s.s2.hint.1: Imagine each reply as text with no voice tone: 민호 fit read am in two opposite ways?
n-k-k4-04.s.s2.r.a: This clearly say no for now.
n-k-k4-04.s.s2.explain: Bare 괜찮아요 fit sound like yes or no. Clear refusal or acceptance (안 먹을게요, 주세요) no.
n-k-k4-04.s.s3.prompt: 민호 offer snack. You no want one now, but maybe later. Reply in polite Korean (-요) so 민호 no misunderstand.
n-k-k4-04.s.s3.hint.0: Clearly say you no go eat now and give short reason.
n-k-k4-04.s.s3.hint.1: Add one more sentence about wetin you might do later.
n-k-k4-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: 민호 know say I say no now?
n-k-k4-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: 민호 know say I might say yes later?
n-k-k4-04.s.s3.modelNote.0: Say no now, give reason, ask for later.

n-k-k4-05.title: Coming home late: one plan, two readers
n-k-k4-05.goal: Tell same news to grandmother and younger brother, changing Korean speech level for each.
n-k-k4-05.material: You get club practice today and go reach home by 7:00, later than usual. Leave note for 할머니 and message for 동생, to whom you use 반말.
n-k-k4-05.thinking.1: Keep same news in two language styles
n-k-k4-05.thinking.2: Notice words that differ by speech level
n-k-k4-05.s.s1.hint.0: Read messages one sentence at a time and check ending of each.
n-k-k4-05.s.s1.hint.1: Check verb for 할머니 dinner too, as well as endings.
n-k-k4-05.s.s1.r.a: Both sentences end the way you talk to friend or younger person, no be 할머니.
n-k-k4-05.s.s1.r.c: First sentence switch to casual speech (올게); the two sentences no match.
n-k-k4-05.s.s1.r.d: Polite, but 먹어요 no show respect to 할머니 like 드세요 do for her meal.
n-k-k4-05.s.s1.explain: Every sentence to 할머니 need -요 or respectful ending, and for her meal use respectful verb 드세요. Casual endings (가, 먹어, 올게) for friends and younger people; mixing levels in one note sound careless.
n-k-k4-05.s.s2.prompt: Write note to 할머니 in Korean. Say you go reach home at 7:00 and why.
n-k-k4-05.s.s2.hint.0: Start by calling her 할머니, then tell time and reason.
n-k-k4-05.s.s2.hint.1: Finish each sentence with -요 or -세요 ending.
n-k-k4-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: I address 할머니 and end every sentence politely?
n-k-k4-05.s.s2.modelNote.0: Polite, reason, time, and caring line.
n-k-k4-05.s.s3.prompt: Now write message to younger brother (동생) with 반말. Give same news: you go reach home at 7:00. Add something you want him to do.
n-k-k4-05.s.s3.hint.0: Say same time, but use endings you use with 동생.
n-k-k4-05.s.s3.hint.1: Add short request (먹어, 해 줘, 기다려 ...).
n-k-k4-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: It carry same news as note to 할머니?
